name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, used to specify deal-specific terms that reference the standard NDA terms.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA created by a committee of 40+ attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering subscription terms, order forms, and service conditions.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard agreement for design partnership arrangements, allowing companies to collaborate with early-stage customers to shape product development.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard SLA terms designed to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement, covering uptime commitments and remedies.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard agreement for professional services engagements, covering statements of work, deliverables, payment terms, and IP ownership.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard agreement governing data processing activities, covering GDPR compliance, data subject rights, security obligations, and sub-processor management.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard agreement for licensing on-premise or hosted software, covering license grants, restrictions, support, and maintenance terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard agreement for establishing business partnerships, covering roles, revenue sharing, intellectual property, and termination provisions.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term contract for product or service evaluation before a full commercial commitment, covering trial scope, duration, fees, and transition to a full agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement for business associates that handle protected health information, covering permitted uses, security safeguards, and breach notification.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum for adding AI-specific terms to existing agreements, covering data usage for model training, AI output ownership, and acceptable use policies.
